sources.snippet: What is HTDemucs? HTDemucs (Hybrid Transformer Demucs) is Meta AI's fourth-generation music source separation model, introduced in Hybrid Transformers for Music Source Separation (Rouard et al., ICASSP 2023). Where earlier Demucs generations processed audio purely in the time domain, HTDemucs runs two parallel encoders simultaneously — one operating on the raw waveform, the other on the STFT ...
